content: Ogre-Next (OGRECave/ogre-next) LICENSE confirmed MIT. RenderSystems present: Direct3D11, OpenGL 3.3+ (GL3Plus), Metal, Vulkan -- listed as equal peers in the repo's Supported Backends list; no explicit documentation found ranking Vulkan RenderSystem maturity below or above the others. Repo shows ~14,720 commits, active CI (Linux/MSVC/Clang-Format), real production users listed -- actively maintained.
